          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Building Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste.json",
          "text": "Copy Paste Gadget",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Copy Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 10
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste.json",
          "text": "The copy paste gadget makes replicating structures far easier! To start, ensure you're in 'copy' mode in the settings menu. Right click one corner of a structure,and then shift-right click an opposing corner. If done correctly, a green outline will surround your structure.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Copy Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 10
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste.json",
          "text": "Copying a structure",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Copy Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 10
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste.json",
          "text": "Switch the gadget to 'paste' mode, and you'll see a ghostly preview of the structure you've copied. The block you right clicked during copying is the starting point of the structure. To place the structure in world, simply right click! All items necessary for building will be removed from your inventory, and any blocks you don't have items for will be skipped.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Copy Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 10
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste.json",
          "text": "Paste Preview",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Copy Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 10
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste.json",
          "text": "Previewing a paste",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Copy Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 10
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste.json",
          "text": "To see a list of the items you need, open the settings menu and choose the 'material list' option. This is a scrollable list showing what items you do or do not have, and can be sorted in multiple ways. Try it out!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Copy Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 10
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste.json",
          "text": "Material List",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.title",
          "label": "Copy Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 10
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste.json",
          "text": "Needed items",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Copy Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 10
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste.json",
          "text": "Its possible to make fine tuned adjustments to the copy area by opening the Adjust Placement window in the settings menu. From here, you can adjust the position of the start block and end block. Click the plus and minus buttons to see the green box change in real time. You can also swap to 'absolute' coordinates mode and enter in-game world coordinates instead.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Copy Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 10
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste.json",
          "text": "Adjusting Copy",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.title",
          "label": "Copy Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 10
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste.json",
          "text": "Changing the area you are copying",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Copy Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 10
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste.json",
          "text": "Theres a similar option for paste mode. In this UI, you'll be adjusting the location of the starting block. Click the buttons and the render should update in-world in real time.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.text",
          "label": "Copy Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 10
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste.json",
          "text": "Adjusting Paste",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.title",
          "label": "Copy Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 10
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste.json",
          "text": "Changing the location of the paste",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.text",
          "label": "Copy Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 10
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste.json",
          "text": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste.json",
          "text": "The cut paste gadget makes moving structures a breeze, and works just like the Copy Paste Gadget! To start, ensure you're in 'cut' mode in the settings menu. Right click one corner of a structure,and then shift-right click an opposing corner. If done correctly, a red outline will surround your structure.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste.json",
          "text": "Cutting a structure",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste.json",
          "text": "The structure will not be removed until you click the 'cut' button in the settings menu. Switch the gadget to 'paste' mode, and you'll see a ghostly preview of the structure you've copied. To place the structure in world, simply right click! No items are necessary for this, as its using the blocks you removed earlier.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste.json",
          "text": "Paste Preview",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste.json",
          "text": "Previewing a paste",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste.json",
          "text": "You can only have one structure stored on the gadget at a time. Placing it in the world will erased the stored information on the gadget. Be careful when pasting the structure, you only get one chance, exchange mode is recommended! If you attempt to cut a new area while data already exists, you'll be prompted to confirm. If you do this, the first set of data will be lost forever!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste.json",
          "text": "All block-entity data will be moved along with the structure, including the contents of chests and block configurations. Much like the Copy Paste Gadget, you can modify the cut or paste positions with the appropriate settings menu option. See that chapter for details!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction.json",
          "text": "Destruction Gadget",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Destruction Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction.json",
          "text": "The destruction gadget makes clearing a large area very easy. Any blocks cleared will be voided!. First, open the settings menu and adjust the area. This area is with respect to the block (and block face) you are looking at. If you look at the top face of a block, 'up' will be relative to the player's screen.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Destruction Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction.json",
          "text": "Destruction Gadget",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Destruction Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction.json",
          "text": "Destroying an area, click the arrow to see diffent pictures!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Destruction Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction.json",
          "text": "Once you're satisfied with the settings, right click on a block to void all the highlighted blocks. They will be removed from the world. You may undo this action if you make a mistake. It will not remove items from your inventory to undo, as the gadget is just returning the voided blocks to the world.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Destruction Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "The exchanging gadget can swap one set of blocks for another! It cannot, however, replace air blocks. Use a Building Gadget for that! First, ensure the gadget has some energy. Second, Shift right-click a block in the world to specify the block to exchange to.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "You can choose your Exchanging Mode by holding the settings key. Each mode is described in its appropriate entry in this book. The default mode is Surface. When looking at a block in the world, you'll see a ghostly image of the blocks that will be placed over top of existing blocks. If you're missing the required items or energy to place these blocks, they will have a red overlay. Right click to exchange the blocks as shown.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "Exchange Preview",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "Seeing a preview of what will be exchanged",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "When you right click, exchanging will begin. Items will be taken out of your inventory to be placed into the world, and any blocks you don't have the necessary item for will be skipped. Items for the removed blocks will be returned to you. Note: You can enchant this tool with silk touch. Without it grass will return dirt, etc.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "You can undo with the exchanging gadget, but you must have the necessary items. For example, if you exchanged grass into stone bricks, you must have grass in your inventory to undo this exchange. Don't forget to apply silk touch if desired!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_anchor",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_anchor.json",
          "text": "Anchor allows you to 'lock in' the block you're looking at, so you can freely move or look around. There is a hotkey for this, or you can access it from the settings menu. You can right click at any time to build the structure when it is anchored. Note: Changing range may not take effect until you remove and replace the anchor.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Anchor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_anchor",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_anchor.json",
          "text": "Anchor your render!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Anchor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_bindinv",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_bindinv.json",
          "text": "Bind Inventory",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Bind Inventory",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_bindinv",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_bindinv.json",
          "text": "Binding to an inventory allows you to interact with that inventory to extract/insert items. First, enable 'bind inventory' mode in the settings menu of your gadget. Then shift-right click on a chest or other inventory. A blue box around the inventory will note your success. Shift-Right click a non inventory block (like grass) to disconnect.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Bind Inventory",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_bindinv",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_bindinv.json",
          "text": "Bind Inventory",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Bind Inventory",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_bindinv",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_bindinv.json",
          "text": "Binding to a Chest!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Bind Inventory",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_bindinv",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_bindinv.json",
          "text": "You can also bind to an Applied Energistics 2 System by connecting to the wireless access point of that system. The gadget will have unlimited range, so no need to worry about range upgrades!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Bind Inventory",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

      "semantic_evidence": [
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management.json",
          "text": "Inventory Management",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Inventory Management",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management.json",
          "text": "Inventory Management",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Inventory Management",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management.json",
          "text": "So you've got a few Vessels and you've made a few Wooden Chests, but you still have more items than you know what to do with. What's next? A Backpack can double your on-person inventory at base level, and further backpack upgrades increase it even more!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Inventory Management",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management.json",
          "text": "Backpacks can carry multiple heavy items without encumbering you, as well as big items like stacks of logs. You can even upgrade it with a Crafting Upgrade to have a Crafting Table with you everywhere.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Inventory Management",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management.json",
          "text": "For storage, GregTech has Crates which can hold all the bigger items a backpack can, and different tiers can hold more and more items. Crates can also have Item Filters and Item Tag Filters put on them if you'd like to make a basic sorting system. Item Pipes don't pull by themselves though, so you'll need a Chute or Hopper to push into them.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Inventory Management",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management.json",
          "text": "For storing fluids, GregTech has Drums. These can hold a large amount of a single fluid type, and different tiers hold more, just like with crates. Unlike crates, drums will retain their fluid when broken, making them ideal for moving fluids around. Drums can automatically push their fluid out of their bottom face by right-clicking them with a Soft Mallet or Screwdriver.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Inventory Management",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management.json",
          "text": "Place the drum in a crafting grid to clear its contents.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Inventory Management",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management.json",
          "text": "Super Storage",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.title",
          "label": "Inventory Management",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management.json",
          "text": "Are you producing an item on an industrial scale? GregTech's Super Chests and Super Tanks can hold a silly amount of a single item type, and can even void any overflow.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Inventory Management",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management.json",
          "text": "Applied Energistics 2",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.title",
          "label": "Inventory Management",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/inventory_management.json",
          "text": "Available at the end of HV, AE2 can provide everything you'd ever want for storage and logistics.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Inventory Management",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "applied_energistics_2",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "With your first step on the Moon comes access to your first Certus Quartz vein.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Don't worry, they're quite common and should be easy to locate, though having a decent Ore Prospector wouldn't hurt.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Whether you decide to set up a miner or manually dig out a full vein, make sure to gather a hefty amount, as you'll need it to progress through AE2.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "One small step for you, one giant leap for logistics",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(gtceu:poor_raw_certus_quartz)item(gtceu:raw_certus_quartz)item(gtceu:rich_raw_certus_quartz))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Certus Quartz Ore",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Certus Quartz",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "One of your main resources for Applied Energistics 2 will be Charged Certus Quartz.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "To obtain it, there’s really only one method: the HV Polarizer.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "You’ll quickly notice how long this recipe takes, so it’s strongly recommended to dedicate a Polarizer exclusively to this task.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "It may seem expensive or daunting at first, but don't worry—it’s absolutely worth it.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Also, remember not to charge all your Certus Quartz!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "You’ll need some uncharged ones for items like the Annihilation Core, so always keep a small reserve on hand.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Redstone isn't enough",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The Sifter is used for ore processing to increase your yield of Certus Quartz, Quartzite, Nether Quartz, Ruby, and Armalcolite—all of which are essential for AE2. Alternatively, you can smelt the ores directly in a Furnace if you're in a rush, but you'll lose out on a lot of free resources by doing that.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The second machine, the Mixer, is your only method to create Fluix Crystals (more about that in the next quest). Don’t forget that you can also use the Greate Mixer as a HS-tier machine.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Thirdly, a Laser Engraver can combine lesser quality gems together into Exquisite, which will give you better Fluix yields.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Lastly, keep in mind that an Autoclave can help you generate even more gems from dusts. Once you have the resources, crafting one will make your life significantly easier.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Or is it four?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(gtceu:hv_mixer)item(greate:stainless_steel_mechanical_mixer))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Greate or GregTech?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(vintageimprovements:vibrating_table)item(gtceu:lv_sifter)item(gtceu:mv_sifter)item(gtceu:hv_sifter)item(gtceu:ev_sifter)item(gtceu:iv_sifter)item(gtceu:luv_sifter)item(gtceu:zpm_sifter)item(gtceu:uv_sifter))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Any Sifter",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The Three Musketeers",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "As you can see, there are multiple ways to create Fluix Crystals using a Mixer.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The higher the purity of your input gems, the better the yield — that’s exactly why we recommended crafting a Sifter earlier.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "You’ll need a massive amount of Fluix Crystals, especially since the liquid version is used in most Applied Energistics 2 recipes.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "So prepare yourself—you’re going to need a lot!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Energetic Crystal",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Most of your Fluix Crystals will be converted into Liquid Fluix.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "However, make sure to keep a few in their crystal form for the occasional recipe that specifically requires it.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Any Extractor will do the job here — no need for anything fancy.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The precious fluix",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(gtceu:lv_extractor)item(gtceu:mv_extractor)item(gtceu:hv_extractor)item(gtceu:ev_extractor))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Any Extractor",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Fluid Extractor",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "We told you you'd need a vast quantity of Liquid Fluix… but we didn’t mention there’s a way to drastically increase your yield per Fluix Crystal.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Introducing: Cryogenized Fluix, an ultra-cold fluid only craftable on the Moon using a Vacuum Freezer. Simply combine Liquid Fluix with Helium-3!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "This special fluid can be used as a substitute in nearly all recipes that require Liquid Fluix—but only when you're crafting on the Moon.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Moon-based AE2 recipes come with huge benefits: reduced energy costs, less components needed, or sometimes both! Investing in a proper Moon base for AE2 production will pay off massively, especially in early game.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "It’s not strictly mandatory — yet. But setting up a second base now will ease your future progression, as planet-based infrastructure becomes essential later on. So… why not get ahead of the curve?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The Moon is so cheap",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Liquid Fluix",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Here you are, ready to begin your AE2 infrastructure!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "This chapter will mainly guide you through what you can and cannot craft yet.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "We’ll also highlight the most important items you should focus on.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "However, to fully understand Applied Energistics 2, we strongly recommend using the G keybind (similar to Create's Ponder system) or open the ME Guide we provide as a reward from this quest. It’s the best in-game tutorial for AE2.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Alternatively, watch some online videos about AE2 on 1.20.1 for more detailed explanations — AE2 is a very popular mod, so there's a ton of tutorials out there!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Pro tip: Many AE2 recipes have alternative Moon recipes that are much cheaper. Once again, investing in your Moon base will greatly reward you throughout the entire game.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Another free book for your collection!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Welcome to AE2",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "To get started, you’ll need to power your ME Network. These are the two AE2 blocks that can directly accept EU energy.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }
      ],
      "aliases": []
    },

      "semantic_evidence": [
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "Leather Making",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "Leather is a sturdy material formed from animal hides. It is required to craft Armor, Saddles, or a Bellows. Raw Hides must be treated through several processes: soaking, scraping, preparing, and tanning to turn them into Leather.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "Raw Hide",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "To get started you will first need to obtain Raw Hide, which is dropped when slaughtering many different Animals. Different animals will drop different sizes of Raw Hide.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "Leather making will require several materials and tools. You will need: - Limewater - a solution of Flux in Water - Water - Tannin - an acidic solution made from the bark of some trees. - Raw Hides With all that on hand, you are ready to begin the leather working process.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "First, raw hides must be soaked to clean them and loosen unwanted material before processing. This can be done by sealing some Raw Hide in a Barrel of Limewater for at least eight hours.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "After soaking, Soaked Hides must be scraped which removes any excess material. In order to scrape hides, place the hide on the side of a Log. With a Knife, on each part of the hide and it will start to change texture.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "Once the hide is fully scraped, it can be broken to pick up a Scraped Hide.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "After scraping, Scraped Hides must be sealed in a Barrel of Water for at least eight hours, for one final cleaning before tanning.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "Finally, Prepared Hides must be sealed in a Barrel of Tannin, which is an acidic chemical compound that helps to convert the hide to Leather. After another eight hours, you can remove the Leather from the barrel.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "advancement",
          "id": "tfc:story/leather",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!data/tfc/advancements/story/leather.json",
          "text": "Genuine Leather",
          "key": "advancement-title:title",
          "label": "Genuine Leather",
          "item_ref_count": 1
        },
        {
          "kind": "advancement",
          "id": "tfc:story/leather",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!data/tfc/advancements/story/leather.json",
          "text": "Finish preparing the hide by soaking it in water then tannin",
          "key": "advancement-description:description",
          "label": "Genuine Leather",
          "item_ref_count": 1

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/buildinggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/buildinggadget.json",
          "text": "Building Gadget",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Building Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/buildinggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/buildinggadget.json",
          "text": "The building gadget makes building a large number of blocks all at once extremely easy! First, ensure the gadget has some energy. Second, Shift right-click a block in the world to specify the block to build with.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Building Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/buildinggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/buildinggadget.json",
          "text": "You can choose your Building Mode by holding the settings key. Each mode is described in its appropriate entry in this book. The default mode is Build to Me. When looking at a block in the world, you'll see a ghostly image of the blocks that will be placed. If you're missing the required items or energy to place these blocks, they will have a red overlay. Right click to place the blocks as shown.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Building Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/buildinggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/buildinggadget.json",
          "text": "Build Preview",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Building Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/buildinggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/buildinggadget.json",
          "text": "Seeing a preview of what will be built",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Building Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/buildinggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/buildinggadget.json",
          "text": "When you right click, building will begin. Items will be taken out of your inventory to be placed into the world, and any blocks you don't have the necessary item for will be skipped. Don't forget you can undo if you make a mistake!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Building Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste.json",

          "count": 10
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/copypaste.json",
          "text": "The copy paste gadget makes replicating structures far easier! To start, ensure you're in 'copy' mode in the settings menu. Right click one corner of a structure,and then shift-right click an opposing corner. If done correctly, a green outline will surround your structure.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",

          "count": 10
        },
        {

          "text": "To see a list of the items you need, open the settings menu and choose the 'material list' option. This is a scrollable list showing what items you do or do not have, and can be sorted in multiple ways. Try it out!",

        {

        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste",

          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste.json",
          "text": "The cut paste gadget makes moving structures a breeze, and works just like the Copy Paste Gadget! To start, ensure you're in 'cut' mode in the settings menu. Right click one corner of a structure,and then shift-right click an opposing corner. If done correctly, a red outline will surround your structure.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste.json",
          "text": "Cutting a structure",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste.json",
          "text": "The structure will not be removed until you click the 'cut' button in the settings menu. Switch the gadget to 'paste' mode, and you'll see a ghostly preview of the structure you've copied. To place the structure in world, simply right click! No items are necessary for this, as its using the blocks you removed earlier.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste.json",
          "text": "Paste Preview",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste.json",
          "text": "Previewing a paste",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste.json",
          "text": "You can only have one structure stored on the gadget at a time. Placing it in the world will erased the stored information on the gadget. Be careful when pasting the structure, you only get one chance, exchange mode is recommended! If you attempt to cut a new area while data already exists, you'll be prompted to confirm. If you do this, the first set of data will be lost forever!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste.json",
          "text": "All block-entity data will be moved along with the structure, including the contents of chests and block configurations. Much like the Copy Paste Gadget, you can modify the cut or paste positions with the appropriate settings menu option. See that chapter for details!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction.json",
          "text": "Destruction Gadget",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Destruction Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction.json",
          "text": "The destruction gadget makes clearing a large area very easy. Any blocks cleared will be voided!. First, open the settings menu and adjust the area. This area is with respect to the block (and block face) you are looking at. If you look at the top face of a block, 'up' will be relative to the player's screen.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Destruction Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction.json",
          "text": "Destruction Gadget",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Destruction Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction.json",
          "text": "Destroying an area, click the arrow to see diffent pictures!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Destruction Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction.json",
          "text": "Once you're satisfied with the settings, right click on a block to void all the highlighted blocks. They will be removed from the world. You may undo this action if you make a mistake. It will not remove items from your inventory to undo, as the gadget is just returning the voided blocks to the world.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Destruction Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "The exchanging gadget can swap one set of blocks for another! It cannot, however, replace air blocks. Use a Building Gadget for that! First, ensure the gadget has some energy. Second, Shift right-click a block in the world to specify the block to exchange to.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "You can choose your Exchanging Mode by holding the settings key. Each mode is described in its appropriate entry in this book. The default mode is Surface. When looking at a block in the world, you'll see a ghostly image of the blocks that will be placed over top of existing blocks. If you're missing the required items or energy to place these blocks, they will have a red overlay. Right click to exchange the blocks as shown.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "Exchange Preview",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "Seeing a preview of what will be exchanged",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "When you right click, exchanging will begin. Items will be taken out of your inventory to be placed into the world, and any blocks you don't have the necessary item for will be skipped. Items for the removed blocks will be returned to you. Note: You can enchant this tool with silk touch. Without it grass will return dirt, etc.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "You can undo with the exchanging gadget, but you must have the necessary items. For example, if you exchanged grass into stone bricks, you must have grass in your inventory to undo this exchange. Don't forget to apply silk touch if desired!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_anchor",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_anchor.json",
          "text": "Anchor allows you to 'lock in' the block you're looking at, so you can freely move or look around. There is a hotkey for this, or you can access it from the settings menu. You can right click at any time to build the structure when it is anchored. Note: Changing range may not take effect until you remove and replace the anchor.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Anchor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_anchor.json",

          "count": 2
        },
        {

          "label": "Bind Inventory",
          "item_ref_count": 6,

        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "label": "Bind Inventory",

        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_bindinv",

          "text": "Binding to a Chest!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Bind Inventory",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_bindinv",

          "text": "You can also bind to an Applied Energistics 2 System by connecting to the wireless access point of that system. The gadget will have unlimited range, so no need to worry about range upgrades!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Bind Inventory",
          "item_ref_count": 6,

        },
        {

          "text": "Binding to AE2!",

        },
        {
